_comment: Independent Motion (transform) projection contract. The Motion layer maps an element's declared entrance/exit motion to a transform state (dy, scale, alpha) at time t. This contract is the EXPECTED side; it must never be imported from the renderer. Pure smoothstep easing, matching the declared production vocabulary.
_observability_comment: Which element types a transform channel is OBSERVABLE on. 'dy' shifts the element's whole box, so it affects every type. 'scale' is only multiplied into the rendered geometry for text and motif; on chart/decor/shape/connector the scale channel is not applied, so a pop/shrink there is not observable in ink and must NOT be adjudicated (declarative, auditable, not hardcoded).
